sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the applicability and calculation semantics: constrain only narrow deck strips abreast of hatches that serve as ice stringers; compare both actual section modulus and actual shear area against the formula-derived requirements of 4.5.1 and 4.5.2 rather than checking section-modulus presence and using requiredShearArea from an unrelated clause; and encode the classification-society-permitted very-long-hatch p*h reduction as less than 0.15 but never less than 0.10. Locate canonical terms for the missing abreast-of-hatch relation, required section-modulus/formula operands, p*h value, very-long-hatch condition, and permission evidence, then preserve correct decimal datatypes and unit conversions.
